teams.detail: Swept by Miami with an 8-4 series-finale loss Thursday, falling to .500 at 47-47 and slipping behind Texas in a tightly bunched AL West. Next: at the AL East-leading Rays, Friday-Sunday at Tropicana Field, with the club in danger of hitting the All-Star break under .500.

Dropped their Vegas Summer League opener to Philadelphia 101-93 Thursday at Cox Pavilion; Isaac Jones (22 pts, 4 reb, 2 blk) and No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie (20 pts, 4 ast, 2 stl) paced Detroit in his pro debut. Next: vs. Cleveland, Sunday 7/12 at Thomas & Mack Center.

Two ownership groups remain frontrunners to buy the Super Bowl champions — one led by 49ers investor Vinod Khosla, the other by Celtics minority owner Aditya Mittal and former Celtics governor Wyc Grousbeck — with a sale north of $10B possible by August. Training camp opens July 24 in Renton.

UW landed a commitment from 4-star edge rusher Chaz Gray within the past 24 hours and remains in the mix for a cornerback and two offensive linemen after already adding Colorado lineman Reis Russell. RB Jordan Washington is still targeting a late-July return from his spring injury.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, adding guards Steele Venters (Gonzaga) and Parker Friedrichsen (Davidson) this offseason.

headlines.headline: NBA offseason erupts: four-team trade sends LaMelo Ball to Timberwolves, Julius Randle to Nets
headlines.detail: A four-team blockbuster is sending LaMelo Ball to the Timberwolves, Julius Randle to the Nets, Naz Reid to the Hornets and Nic Claxton to the Bulls, while the Lakers separately traded Deandre Ayton to the Wizards for Jaden Hardy and two second-round picks. Washington also locked up Trae Young on a four-year, $212 million extension, and the Kawhi Leonard-to-Raptors deal remains on hold pending an NBA investigation.

headlines.headline: Former Lions CB Terrion Arnold takes physical with Texans after release amid felony charges
headlines.detail: Terrion Arnold, released by Detroit on June 29 following his arrest on eight felony charges tied to a February robbery and kidnapping in Tampa, took a physical with the Texans in Houston on Thursday. A judge ruled Friday that Arnold does not need to wear a GPS tracker as a condition of his release.

headlines.headline: Penn State's Matt Campbell builds roster around 24 Iowa State transfers led by QB Rocco Becht
headlines.detail: New head coach Matt Campbell brought 24 of his former Iowa State players with him to Penn State as part of a 48-player transfer haul, headlined by quarterback Rocco Becht, who carries 26 career wins as a starter — the most of any returning FBS quarterback in 2026 — plus top-15 skill talents Chase Sowell and Carson Hansen.

headlines.headline: St. John's Donnie Freeman to miss entire 2026-27 season after Achilles surgery
headlines.detail: Rising junior forward Donnie Freeman ruptured his Achilles during a team workout earlier this week and underwent surgery, sidelining him for all of next season and dealing a major blow to St. John's projected roster. The news lands as ESPN's early Top 25 for next season, led by defending champion Duke, circulates across the sport's slow offseason stretch.
